name: esposter
description: Claude Code plugins that live in the Esposter monorepo.

plugins.name: follow-ups
plugins.description: Writes the follow-ups a session leaves unfinished into an Esposter TodoList, and drains them again one change at a time until none is left.

plugins.name: genshin-mods
plugins.description: Five mods under one band above the prompt: the next steps one press each, the cache and usage with a one-click handoff, recording mode, a goal's task list and a question before editing a file another session just changed.

plugins.name: genshin-persona
plugins.description: Speaks as the Genshin Impact character whose birthday is nearest to today, and reads each reply aloud, a sentence at a time, in the character's own cloned voice.
